taxes.name: Massachusetts deeds excise (tax stamps)
taxes.source_title: Mass DOR Directive 95-4: Enforcement of the Deeds Excise; Salem Deeds excise page; M.G.L. c.64D s.1
taxes.notes: $2.28 per $500 of consideration (= $2 per $500 under c.64D s.1 plus 14% surcharge) = $4.56 per $1,000; consideration excludes liens/encumbrances remaining at sale; applies above $100. DOR: 'paid by the person who makes or signs the deed' (grantor/seller). Barnstable County differs ($1.71 per $500). Corroborating: https://salemdeeds.com/SalemDeeds/fees_excise.aspx and https://malegislature.gov/Laws/GeneralLaws/PartI/TitleIX/Chapter64D/Section1. No Boston city transfer tax found. No mortgage tax. No primary-residence exemption.

taxes.name: NYS real estate transfer tax (base)
taxes.source_title: NYS Dept of Taxation: Real estate transfer tax
taxes.notes: $2 per $500 of consideration. Grantor (seller) pays; grantee pays only if seller fails/exempt or contract shifts it.

taxes.name: NYS additional base tax (NYC, residential >= $3M)
taxes.source_title: NYS TSB-M-19(1)R; NYS real estate transfer tax page
taxes.notes: $1.25 per $500 on ENTIRE consideration when residential conveyance in NYC is $3M or more (so state base becomes 0.65%). Seller pays.

taxes.name: NYS 'mansion tax' (additional tax, residential >= $1M)
taxes.source_title: NYS Dept of Taxation: Real estate transfer tax
taxes.notes: 1% of the entire price for residential consideration of $1M or more. Buyer (grantee) pays. Applies statewide incl. co-ops.

taxes.name: NYS supplemental tax (NYC residential >= $2M; stacks on mansion tax)
taxes.source_title: NYS TSB-M-19(1)R: Amendments to the Real Estate Transfer Tax
taxes.notes: Computed on entire consideration for wholly residential property. Buyer pays (seller if buyer fails/exempt). Combined with the 1% mansion tax gives 1.25% at $2-3M up to 3.9% at $25M+.

taxes.name: NYC Real Property Transfer Tax (RPTT), residential Type 1/2
taxes.source_title: NYC Dept of Finance: Real Property Transfer Tax (RPTT)
taxes.notes: 1-3 family houses, condo units, co-op units: 1% if value is $500,000 or less; 1.425% if above $500,000 (rate on whole price). Applies to transfers over $25,000. DOF page does not name payer ('usually paid as part of closing costs'; both sign return); customarily the seller (grantor) - payer not confirmed on fetched page.

taxes.name: NYC mortgage recording tax (city + state), borrower share
taxes.source_title: NYC DOF 2022 Mortgage Recording Tax Annual Report; NY Tax Law s.253
taxes.notes: Tier chosen by mortgage amount, rate applied to whole loan. DOF report: residential (1-3 family, condo) combined 2.05% (<$500k) / 2.175% (>=$500k), which includes the 0.25% state 'special additional tax'. Under Tax Law s.253(1-a)(a) (https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/laws/TAX/253) the special additional tax on small residential property is paid by the mortgagee and may not be passed to the mortgagor; borrower share therefore 1.8% / 1.925%. Co-op purchases are financed with share loans and do not pay MRT.

taxes.name: DC deed recordation tax
taxes.source_title: DC OTR: Recorder of Deeds / recordation & transfer tax rates
taxes.notes: Residential: 1.1% if under $400,000; 1.45% on the ENTIRE amount at $400,000+. Customarily buyer (OTR rate page does not name payer; ROD-11 says first-time-buyer recordation benefit goes entirely to grantee). First-time DC homebuyers meeting income/price limits: recordation rate 0.725% (https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/otr/publication/attachments/ROD%2011%20-%20Reduced%20Recordation%20Tax%20Rate%20for%20First-Time%20Homebuyers%20FY2026.pdf).

taxes.name: DC deed transfer tax
taxes.source_title: DC OTR: Recorder of Deeds / recordation & transfer tax rates
taxes.notes: Same rates as recordation tax. ROD-11: 'the full amount of the transfer tax ... should be allocated to the transferor' (seller). No separate recordation tax on purchase-money deed of trust found on fetched page (only $150 recording fee).

taxes.name: Pennsylvania realty transfer tax (state)
taxes.source_title: PA Dept of Revenue: Realty Transfer Tax
taxes.notes: 1% of value. Grantor and grantee jointly and severally liable; customary 50/50 split (custom not stated on fetched page).

taxes.name: Philadelphia realty transfer tax (city)
taxes.source_title: City of Philadelphia: Philly's realty transfer tax rate is now 4.578%
taxes.notes: 3.578% effective July 1, 2025 (was 3.278%); combined with state = 4.578%. Base is sale price (or OPA assessed value if no price). Payer not stated on page; modeled as customary 50/50 split.

taxes.name: NC excise tax on conveyances (revenue stamps)
taxes.source_title: N.C.G.S. Chapter 105 Article 8E
taxes.notes: $1 per $500 (or fraction). Paid by the transferor (grantor). Proceeds split county/state. No additional Wake County transfer tax found.

taxes.name: NC excise tax on conveyances (revenue stamps)
taxes.source_title: N.C.G.S. Chapter 105 Article 8E
taxes.notes: $1 per $500. Paid by transferor. No additional Mecklenburg County transfer tax found.

taxes.name: Georgia real estate transfer tax
taxes.source_title: Georgia DOR: Real Estate Transfer Tax
taxes.notes: $1 for first $1,000 plus $0.10 per additional $100 (= 0.1%). Seller liable; contract may shift to buyer. Base excludes pre-existing liens not removed by sale (O.C.G.A. 48-6-1, https://law.justia.com/codes/georgia/title-48/chapter-6/article-1/section-48-6-1).

taxes.name: Georgia intangible recording tax (on long-term note)
taxes.source_title: Georgia DOR: Intangible Recording Tax
taxes.notes: $1.50 per $500 of note face amount; maximum $25,000 per note. Legally collected from the note holder (lender), who may pass it to the borrower; customarily borrower-paid closing cost.

taxes.name: Florida documentary stamp tax on deeds
taxes.source_title: Florida DOR: Documentary Stamp Tax overview (tutorial)
taxes.notes: $0.70 per $100 (all counties except Miami-Dade). All parties are liable; seller customarily pays (custom not stated on DOR page).

taxes.name: Florida documentary stamp tax on mortgage/note
taxes.source_title: Florida DOR: Documentary Stamp Tax overview (tutorial)
taxes.notes: $0.35 per $100; no cap for recorded mortgages (unsecured notes capped at $2,450).

taxes.name: Florida nonrecurring intangible tax on mortgage
taxes.source_title: Fla. Stat. 199.133; Florida DOR Nonrecurring Intangible Tax
taxes.notes: 2 mills per dollar. DOR (https://floridarevenue.com/taxes/taxesfees/Pages/nonrecurring_intangible_tax.aspx): lender is the taxpayer liable but may pass cost to borrower.

taxes.name: Florida documentary stamp tax on deeds (Miami-Dade rate)
taxes.source_title: Florida DOR: Documentary Stamp Tax overview (tutorial)
taxes.notes: $0.60 per $100 in Miami-Dade. Plus $0.45 per $100 discretionary surtax that does NOT apply to deeds conveying only a single-family residence; condos/other property pay 0.60% + 0.45% = 1.05%. Seller customarily pays.

taxes.name: Florida documentary stamp tax on mortgage/note
taxes.source_title: Florida DOR: Documentary Stamp Tax overview (tutorial)
taxes.notes: $0.35 per $100; no cap for recorded mortgages.

taxes.name: Florida nonrecurring intangible tax on mortgage
taxes.source_title: Fla. Stat. 199.133
taxes.notes: 2 mills; lender liable, may pass to borrower.

taxes.name: Illinois state real estate transfer tax
taxes.notes: 50 cents per $500 of value. Payer not stated in fetched section; customarily seller.

taxes.name: Cook County real property transfer tax
taxes.source_title: Cook County news release: pursuing unpaid taxes on real estate sales
taxes.notes: 25 cents per $500 of transfer price; county enforces against sellers.

taxes.name: Chicago real property transfer tax (city portion)
taxes.source_title: City of Chicago Dept of Finance: Real Property Transfer Tax (7551)
taxes.notes: $3.75 per $500, generally paid by buyer. No graduated rates listed on page.

taxes.name: Chicago CTA portion of real property transfer tax
taxes.source_title: City of Chicago Dept of Finance: Real Property Transfer Tax (7551)
taxes.notes: $1.50 per $500, generally paid by seller. Refund available to buyers 65+ who occupy as residence 1 yr with price <= $250,000.

taxes.name: Minnesota deed tax (incl. Hennepin environmental response fund)
taxes.source_title: Minnesota DOR: Deed Tax Rate
taxes.notes: 0.33% of net consideration statewide + 0.01% ERF in Hennepin and Ramsey = 0.34%. Payer not stated on page; customarily seller.

taxes.name: Minnesota mortgage registry tax (incl. Hennepin ERF)
taxes.source_title: Minnesota DOR: Mortgage Registry and Deed Tax
taxes.notes: 0.23% of debt secured + 0.01% ERF in Hennepin/Ramsey = 0.24%. Payer not stated; customarily borrower.

taxes.name: Ohio real property conveyance fee (state mandatory portion)
taxes.source_title: Ohio Revised Code 319.54(G)(3)
taxes.notes: 10 cents per $100 of value.

taxes.name: Cuyahoga County permissive real property transfer tax
taxes.source_title: Cuyahoga County Fiscal Officer: Procedures for transferring ownership; ORC 322.02
taxes.notes: County page states total conveyance fee of $4.00 per $1,000 of purchase price (page also says '.04%', inconsistent; $4/$1,000 = 0.4%). Permissive portion = 0.4% - 0.1% state. ORC 322.02 (https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-revised-code/section-322.02): max 30 cents per $100, 'levied upon the grantor'.

taxes.name: Michigan state real estate transfer tax
taxes.source_title: State Real Estate Transfer Tax Act (MCL Act 330 of 1993)
taxes.notes: $3.75 per $500. Seller/grantor liable. Exemption 6(u): principal residence (7cc) sales at arm's length where SEV at sale is <= SEV when seller acquired it (rare in rising markets; refundable).

taxes.name: Wayne County real estate transfer tax
taxes.source_title: Wayne County Register of Deeds: Document Recording
taxes.notes: $0.55 per $500 (page: county + state = $8.60 per $1,000). Seller customarily/legally pays (county act liability not fetched).

dallas.notes: No state or local real estate transfer tax. Texas Constitution Art. 8 Sec. 29 is titled 'Transfer Tax on Transaction Conveying Fee Simple Title to Real Property' (referenced in https://capitol.texas.gov/tlodocs/89R/analysis/html/HJ00002E.htm); full text not fetched. Only ordinary recording fees.

austin.notes: Same as Dallas: no transfer tax or mortgage tax in Texas.

taxes.name: Colorado documentary fee
taxes.source_title: C.R.S. 39-13-102; Denver Clerk & Recorder: Record Documents
taxes.notes: 1 cent per $100 ($0.10 per $1,000) when consideration > $500. Statute (https://colorado.public.law/statutes/crs_39-13-102) imposes it on the person offering the deed for recording (typically buyer side). Denver page lists no separate transfer tax.

phoenix.notes: No transfer tax. Prop 100 (2008) amended AZ Constitution to bar state/local taxes or fees on sale/transfer of real property (except those existing before 12/31/2007, e.g. $2 recorder fee per deed/affidavit). Source: https://www.azjlbc.gov/ballot/100fn.pdf

taxes.name: Nevada real property transfer tax (Clark County rate)
taxes.source_title: Nevada Dept of Taxation: Real Property Transfer Tax; Clark County Recorder Declaration of Value packet
taxes.notes: $1.95 per $500 base + $0.60 Clark County = $2.55 per $500 (confirmed in https://files.clarkcountynv.gov/Recorder/Forms/DV_Packet.pdf). Pages do not name payer; buyer and seller jointly and severally liable for deficiencies (NRS 375.030). Modeled as customary seller-paid (negotiable).

taxes.name: Los Angeles County documentary transfer tax
taxes.source_title: LA County Registrar-Recorder: Documentary Transfer Taxes
taxes.notes: $0.55 per $500 ($1.10 per $1,000), consideration excluding liens remaining. Payer not stated; customarily seller in LA.

taxes.name: City of Los Angeles real property transfer tax (base)
taxes.source_title: LA County Registrar-Recorder: Documentary Transfer Taxes (City of LA, Code 44)
taxes.notes: $2.25 per $500 = 0.45%, separate from (not credited against) county tax. Customarily seller.

taxes.name: City of Los Angeles Measure ULA ('mansion tax') surcharge
taxes.source_title: LA County Registrar-Recorder: Documentary Transfer Taxes (City of LA rates table)
taxes.notes: Effective 7/1/26: 4% of total value for sales above $5,400,000 and below $10,900,000; 5.5% at $10,900,000+ (7/1/25-6/30/26 thresholds were $5.3M/$10.6M). Thresholds CPI-indexed each July 1. Whole price, on top of base 0.45%. Pending Nov-2026 ballot items (Palisades fire exemption, new multifamily exemption) per law-firm summary https://www.hansonbridgett.com/publications/260812_7087_ula-ordinance-updates. Payer: customarily seller.

san-diego.jurisdiction: City of San Diego (San Diego County)

taxes.name: San Diego County documentary transfer tax
taxes.source_title: San Diego County Assessor/Recorder/County Clerk: Recording
taxes.notes: $0.55 per $500 (R&T 11911). Collected 'for the county and cities'; under R&T 11911(b)-(c) a city tax of half the county rate is credited against the county tax, so no net additional city tax. No separate City of San Diego tax found. Payer customary/negotiable (seller assumed; a non-official guide says it is often split).

san-francisco.jurisdiction: City and County of San Francisco

taxes.name: San Francisco real property transfer tax
taxes.source_title: SF.gov: Transfer tax
taxes.notes: Per $500: $2.50 (>$100-$250k), $3.40 ($250k-<$1M), $3.75 ($1M-<$5M), $11.25 ($5M-<$10M), $27.50 ($10M-<$25M), $30.00 ($25M+). Bracket is chosen by the 'entire value or consideration' and applied to the whole value. SF is a consolidated city-county; no separate county DTT on top. Payer not stated on page; customarily seller.

taxes.name: Washington state real estate excise tax (graduated)
taxes.source_title: WA DOR: Real estate excise tax (REET)
taxes.notes: Rates apply to the portion of selling price in each band (marginal). Current thresholds effective 1/1/2023; new thresholds effective 1/1/2027 (adjusted every 4 years, RCW 82.45.060). Seller usually pays; buyer liable if seller does not. Plus $5 technology fee.

taxes.name: Seattle local REET
taxes.source_title: WA DOR local REET rate table (84-0013, effective May 1, 2026)
taxes.notes: Seattle location code 1726: 0.50%, added to state REET.

portland.notes: No state transfer tax and none in Multnomah County. ORS 306.815 (https://oregon.public.law/statutes/ors_306.815) bars local taxes on transfer of fee estates except those in effect on March 31, 1997 - Washington County's is the grandfathered one. See alt_jurisdictions for Washington County (west suburbs; small part of Portland).

taxes.name: Washington County (OR) real property transfer tax
taxes.source_title: Washington County OR Assessment & Taxation: Transfer tax exemption
taxes.notes: $1 per $1,000 of selling price. 'Liability for the tax is between the purchaser and seller' (customarily split). Exemption form J.13 for transfers under $13,999.

notes: Rates as decimals. 'whole_price_tiers' = the tier is selected by total price (or loan amount for base=mortgage) and that rate applies to the whole amount (mansion-tax style); 'marginal_tiers' = each rate applies only to the portion within the band. Tier boundaries are half-open [from, to): a value equal to 'to' falls in the next tier (DC 1.45% at >= $400,000; NYC MRT higher tier at >= $500,000; NY thresholds 'or more'). NYC RPTT is 1% at <= $500,000, encoded with to=500000.01. Per-$500/$100 rounding ignored. 'payer' is legal payer where the fetched source said so, otherwise customary practice (flagged in notes); payer is negotiable in most places. Mortgage-based taxes (NY MRT, FL doc stamps on note + intangible, GA intangible, MN mortgage registry) are buyer/borrower costs only when financed. Primary-residence exemptions are rare: only DC first-time homebuyer reduced recordation rate (0.725%) and Michigan state-tax exemption when SEV has not risen since purchase were found. Recording fees (flat $) excluded. Texas, Arizona, Multnomah County OR have no transfer tax.
